note: ADR 0781, 2026-11-23, done: the cause is a lost event: the settings page learned of the session Redo makes only from the service's event `created` and replaced its events listener when the session shown changed, so a batch already posted to the old subscription was dropped and the page stayed on "Session … is not on the service" while undo.spec.ts:268 waited 30 s for the section list; shown by the new spec undo-session-events.spec.ts, which delays the events by 300 ms in the main process and failed on the unfixed source at the registered line (the state asserted by a control: no session.list after session.create, unchanged after 2 s; the same hook without delay passed); fixed by one subscription per connection in SettingsPage.tsx; the new spec 30 of 30 and undo.spec.ts unedited 30 of 30 on Windows under load, no skip, retry or longer limit; the fix reverted is caught (committed mutation); without the delay the time-out did not occur in 30 runs on the unfixed source; npm test 812 passed, 4 failed outside the settings page and undo (two from a stale f447_bench of the main checkout, two with no cause established).
